title: dedicated-autoscaler-burst-controls-and-util-reporting-enhancement
author: Samir Gupta
description: Motivation: customers running Dedicated fleets observed inconsistent burst behaviour and poor visibility into short-window utilization. This PR introduces two coordinated changes: 1) smoother burst tokenbucket tuning and explicit burst window controls per-fleet to reduce sudden capacity spikes that lead to tail latency; 2) richer utilization reporting for Dedicated fleets so ops can correlate burst consumption with autoscaler actions and SLA events. The change set includes runtime changes, telemetry additions, API surface for per-fleet config, unit/integration tests, and Console dashboard wiring. Checklist: - [x] implement tokenbucket smoothing and per-fleet burst window override - [x] add fleet-level metrics (burst_tokens_used, burst_window_seconds, burst_smoothing_factor, instantaneous_utilization) - [x] expose new metrics to Console and update docs - [x] add unit and integration tests for edge cases (queue pressure, rapid successive bursts) - [x] validate default values against production workload traces (see internal playbook link: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-1245) Backwards compatibility: defaults are unchanged; new config is additive and guarded by feature flag. Rollout plan: feature-flagged in main for 2 weeks, enable on a small subset of Dedicated fleets, monitor metrics and error budgets, then enable by default. See related PRs: pr-240512 (previous burst tuning), pr-21437 (earlier autoscaler work).
